fee_notes: The Franchise Fee is $50,000 per restaurant, uniformly imposed. Under certain circumstances, the fee may be waived, reduced, or accepted in installments (interest free, over 1 to 18 months). One franchisee was under a former structure where $25,000 was due at signing in 2023 and the remaining $25,000 due upon opening in 2024. Under a Multi-Unit Restaurant Agreement (MURA), the fee is also $50,000 per location for franchisees committing to 3 or more Nontraditional or Delivery-Only Locations. The fee is fully earned upon payment and non-refundable. An additional $15,000 pre-opening and opening advertising fee is required per restaurant (excluding Nontraditional and Delivery-Only Locations), but is not part of the Franchise Fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay $50,000 as a franchise fee (the "Franchise Fee") to develop a single franchise restaurant, regardless of what type of restaurant you develop.  The Franchise Fee is due upon execution of your signed agreement.  The Franchise Fee is fully earned by us upon payment.  We have no obligation to refund the Franchise Fee for any reason, including if you fail to find an acceptable site.  The Franchise Fee is uniformly imposed, except one franchisee was under the former payment structure where $25,000 was due at signing in 2023, and the remaining $25,000 was due upon opening in 2024.
